title: 第15章 奶爸不易做
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
回到住的地方，小不点正盘膝而坐，静静做着吐纳。
小家伙虽然仍爱玩爱闹，但心智早熟的他，在修练上却非常认真，带着一股常人没有的韧劲，异常努力。
林锋看着暗暗点头，小不点那个族兄石天毅，给小不点带来了很大的压力。
小不点处于入定状态，林锋也不去管他，径自坐在一旁，取出一块半球形，中心凹进去，如同一个大石碗模样的晶石。
这是当初被林锋从中剖开取出天雷玉魄后，留下的石皮，虽然不如天雷玉魄珍贵，但也是一种天材地宝，蕴含了大量雷电精气。
被林锋切开，石皮本来有两块，一块留在了石村，帮助石村的村民和孩子们强化体质，还有一块老村长执意让林锋带上。
林锋从石皮上刮下一些小碎片，这些碎小的晶石，可以作为林锋布置九天动雷引的材料，也正是因为有了这块石皮，林锋才不用从系统兑换雷系晶石，额外省下一笔开支。
“说起来，不仅仅是天雷玉魄，恐怕连这块石皮，本来也是上天为小不点准备的机缘宝物。”林锋心中想道：“我收了小不点为徒，这机缘也便宜了我。”
收拾好刮下的碎晶石，林锋将石皮摆在面前，经过他的刻意打磨，此刻的石皮已经完全是一只大海碗了，一只整体由雷系晶石打磨成的大碗。
之前放在伙房吩咐熬好的兽奶，这时也好了，客栈伙计端进来后，林锋便将兽奶全部倒在雷晶大碗里，想了想，又从怀中取出天雷玉魄。
原先成年人拳头大小的天雷玉魄，经过林锋这些日子来的不断压榨，此时只剩下鸡蛋大小。
林锋已经不准备再从中吸纳灵气帮助自身修练，必须要留下一部分作为北极天磁剑的能量源。
不过除此之外，还可以用来给小不点加加餐。
将天雷玉魄浸泡在兽奶中，林锋以自身的法力导引，将天雷玉魄中的几分雷系灵气融入奶水中。
雷晶大碗和天雷玉魄本就同出一源，有了天雷玉魄灵气的引子，雷晶大碗中的雷电精气顿时也散逸出来，融入盛在碗中的兽奶里。
乳白色散发着阵阵奶香的兽奶顿时翻滚起来，仿佛烧沸了一样，表面不停冒出大大的气泡，然后一个接一个的破裂。
道道细小的蓝紫色电光在奶水中穿梭交织，发出“滋滋”的电流声。
小不点这时终于收了功，从入定状态中清醒过来，刚一醒，小鼻子就吸了两下。
小不点睁开眼，看见林锋和雷晶大碗中的兽奶，顿时发出欢呼：“师父！”一个猛子蹦起来，窜到林锋身边，围着大碗直转悠，两只乌溜溜的大眼睛直盯着兽奶，喃喃说道：“真香。”
林锋笑了笑，从碗中取出天雷玉魄，将大碗递给小不点，叮嘱道：“奶里为师加了料，你喝的时候注意点，以自身法力导引奶中的灵气，要是感到身体受不了，立刻停下来。”

小不点连连点头，喜笑颜开的接过大碗，狼吞虎咽，一会儿就将一碗兽奶吃得干干净净。
小不点吃得痛快，可吃完后副作用也表现出来了，
平日间很可爱的小不点化身了一个问题儿童，像白兔般拥有了一双红红的大眼睛，而且四处乱跑，啊呀的叫个不停。
林锋哭笑不得，都跟这小家伙说了，喝奶的同时要用自身法力导引奶中的灵气，这货倒好，光顾着吃起来痛快，导引灵气的事情全忘脑后勺去了。
眼见小不点化身成小凶兽，四处乱闯，可着劲的折腾，再不制止的话，就要把整个客栈拆掉了。
林锋无奈，只能自己出手制住小不点，等小不点清醒过来，看见师父黑着的脸，顿时明白怎么回事，迷迷糊糊的挠了挠头，小声道：“咿呀，闯祸了。”
把客栈掌柜打发走，林锋又好气又好笑的点了点他的小脑瓜：“在山里抓到母兽，你都直接扑到人家怀里吃奶，现在到了城镇中，再要吃奶就在集市上买。”
“兽奶买回来都用这个碗来盛，以后这是你的专用饭盆了，自己的饭碗自己看好。”
小不点连连点头，美滋滋的把雷晶大碗抱在怀里：“谢谢师父。”
看他高兴的样子，林锋也觉得心中欢喜，又叮嘱了他两句后，林锋盘膝坐下。
林锋细细揣摩北极天磁剑的功用，以及云龙遁和九天动雷引这两门法术，心中思索如何才能将手头已有的牌发挥最大作用。

content_en:
Back at the place where he lived, the little boy was sitting cross-legged, breathing quietly.
Although the little guy still loves to play and make noise, he is very serious in his training due to his precocious mind. He has a tenacity that ordinary people don't have and works extremely hard.
Lin Feng looked at it and nodded secretly. Shi Tianyi, the clan brother of the little boy, put a lot of pressure on the little boy.
The little boy was in a state of trance, so Lin Feng ignored him and sat aside. He took out a hemispherical crystal with a concave center, like a large stone bowl.
This is the stone skin left after Lin Feng cut it open and took out the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul. Although it is not as precious as the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul, it is still a kind of heavenly material and earthly treasure that contains a lot of thunder and lightning essence.
Cut open by Lin Feng, there were originally two pieces of stone skin. One piece was left in Shicun to help the villagers and children of Shicun strengthen their physical fitness, and the other piece the old village chief insisted on letting Lin Feng take with him.
Lin Feng scraped off some small fragments from the stone skin. These small crystal stones can be used as materials for Lin Feng to lay out the Nine Heavens Thunder. It is precisely because of this stone skin that Lin Feng does not need to exchange thunder crystals from the system, saving an extra amount of money.
"Speaking of it, not only the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul, but also this stone skin was originally a chance treasure prepared by God for the little one." Lin Feng thought in his heart: "I accepted the little one as my disciple, and this opportunity also benefited me."
After packing up the scraped crystal stones, Lin Feng placed the stone skin in front of him. After careful polishing, the stone skin at this moment was completely like a sea bowl, a large bowl made entirely of thunder crystals.
The animal milk that had been ordered to be boiled in the kitchen was now ready. After the innkeeper brought it in, Lin Feng poured all the animal milk into the big thunder crystal bowl. After thinking about it, he took out the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul from his arms.
The Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul, which was originally the size of an adult's fist, was now only the size of an egg after Lin Feng's constant squeezing over the past few days.
Lin Feng was no longer prepared to absorb the spiritual energy from it to help him practice. He had to leave part of it as the energy source for the Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword.
But in addition, it can also be used to snack on little ones.
Soaking the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul in the beast's milk, Lin Feng used his own magic power to guide some of the thunder aura in the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul into the milk.
The Thunder Crystal Bowl and the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul come from the same source. With the introduction of the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul Spiritual Qi, the thunder and lightning essence in the Thunder Crystal Bowl immediately dissipated and merged into the animal milk contained in the bowl.
The milky white animal milk exuding a burst of milky fragrance suddenly started rolling, as if it were boiling. Big bubbles kept popping up on the surface, and then burst one after another.
Small blue-purple electric lights shuttled in and out of the milk, making a "sizzling" sound of electricity.
At this time, the little boy finally stopped working and woke up from the state of trance. As soon as he woke up, his little nose sniffed twice.
The little boy opened his eyes and saw the beast's milk in the big bowl of Lin Feng and Lei Jing. He immediately cheered: "Master!" A man jumped up and rushed to Lin Feng's side, wandering around the big bowl. His two big black eyes stared at the beast's milk and murmured: "It smells so good."
Lin Feng smiled, took out the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul from the bowl, handed the big bowl to the little one, and warned: "Master has added ingredients to the milk. Be careful when you drink it. Use your own magic power to guide the spiritual energy in the milk. If you feel that your body can't bear it, stop immediately."
The little boy nodded repeatedly, took the big bowl with a smile, and wolfed down the bowl of animal milk in a short while.
The little one ate happily, but the side effects also appeared after eating.
The usually cute little boy turned into a problem child, with a pair of big red eyes like a white rabbit, running around and making a lot of noises.
Lin Feng didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He told this little guy that when drinking milk, he should use his own magic power to guide the aura in the milk. This guy is so good. He just ate it happily and forgot all about channeling the aura..
Seeing the little boy transforming into a little ferocious beast, running around, he kept trying hard, and if he didn't stop him, he would tear down the entire inn.
Lin Feng had no choice but to restrain the little one by himself. When the little one woke up and saw the dark face of his master, he immediately understood what was going on. He scratched his head in a daze and whispered: "Hey, we got into trouble."
After sending the innkeeper away, Lin Feng nodded his head angrily and amusedly: "When you catch a female beast in the mountains, you jump directly into someone's arms and suck her milk. Now that you're in the town, if you want any more milk, you can buy it at the market."
"Use this bowl to hold the animal milk after you buy it. From now on, this will be your special rice bowl. You can take care of your own rice bowl."
The little one nodded repeatedly and happily held the big thunder crystal bowl in his arms: "Thank you, Master."
Seeing his happy look, Lin Feng also felt happy in his heart. After giving him a few more instructions, Lin Feng sat down cross-legged.
Lin Feng carefully studied the functions of the Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword, as well as the two spells of Yunlong Escape and Nine Heavens Moving Thunder, and thought about how to maximize the effects of the cards he already had.
